summary: Iteration 69: Backend API Tests for Subscription Tiers and GPS Check-in Features. All 25 tests passed (100%). Verified subscription CRUD with 20% platform fee, sessions per week validation (1-7), duplicate rejection, and full lifecycle (accept/decline/pause/resume/cancel). GPS check-in endpoints verified: location setting, radius validation (1-35 miles), trainer/trainee check-in with distance calculation, check-in status, and no-show actions (cancel/wait/proceed).

frontend_issues.note: Frontend is React Native/Expo - cannot be tested via browser. Backend-only testing as requested.
